review_summary: The differential captures the major clinical issues but probabilities needed rebalancing. Cardiac dysfunction is the most urgent condition and should be prioritized, while iron-deficiency anemia and medication-overuse headache require confirmation. Several key investigations (echo, iron studies, renal panel, medication reconciliation, psychiatric screens) are missing, limiting certainty for several lower-ranked diagnoses.
